name: set_text_window_orientation

stack.evidence: func_001CDE88 consumes a window ID and preset index and stores it at window descriptor +0x04; func_0010BB50 maps that preset to the descriptor's geometry orientation and X-axis tilt, which func_0010A4A0 and func_0010AFA0 use to build and transform the window mesh

notes: The preset selects a coupled window geometry orientation and tilt rather than a raw angle.
